name: Wavelet-based Multiresolution Rendering
definition: A multiresolution data description using polynomial spline wavelets to decrease resolution of distant parts and improve rendering performance with little impact on visual quality.
summary: Wavelet-based Multiresolution Rendering is an interactive isosurface method that uses GPU-accelerated wavelet reconstruction and view-dependent error metrics to adaptively select level-of-detail, ensuring continuity by reconstructing necessary neighbors.
